Structure Quality: a Protocol that extends another of its folder is one job with it, and a git reference is read with the libraries the project adopts from (links beside the temporary checkout)
Structure Quality: a base class imported from a module of the project is read as that module's class, so two classes of one name are not mixed up
Structure Quality: a library base class imported under another name is read as the class it names

Structure Quality: an arm that re-declares a library class of its own name takes its members from the library class, and an arm is graded against the Protocol with the smallest share of members lacking

Structure Quality compare and case fixtures leave no temporary checkout (a finally removes and prunes the worktree, the fixtures share one TemporaryDirectory); cases SQ-042 to SQ-049 for layered Protocols, unrelated jobs and the severity of arms off their interface; tests

Structure Quality scope: arms graded by the share of Protocol members they lack on a cubic curve, Protocols that extend others count their inherited members, a demoted plain Protocol beside an arm is named, and layered Protocols in one folder count once

Structure Quality coupling and surface split into small functions: the coupling measure was complexity 27 by its own new budget; offending imports, unit cycles, consumer mentions and the kernel note are one function each, and the surface's mention index and __all__ reading are written once

Structure Quality coupling: front doors and declared entries are not offenses; a name taken from a front door counts only when it resolves to a declared entry; offenders name the unit's entry point; cases SQ-026 to SQ-028

esoi structure-quality --compare: the number and each dimension before and after, offenders fixed and introduced, per-solution scope and per-unit coupling deltas; git references checked out into a temporary worktree; --fast leaves flow unmeasured; public names assess_structure_quality and compare_structure_quality; tests

Component cases state the current behavior: stale results are advice and count only an arm's own code, an unrecorded run stops at the first failure, no BASELINE mark, the page layout; the Sub-intent cell links to the sub-intent's real folder; the structure-quality scorer has a naive baseline
Structure Quality: an arm takes the methods of its base class into account; results re-recorded; the scorer's cases are a live component in the component tests
